description: Shared policy from the org preset; only shipkit's own facts below.
shipkit is public, and Mend's hosted Renovate won't load a private repo's preset into a public repo, so this
extends the public template (TheTechNetwork/Fleetwright-Templates), identical to the private fleetwright-templates-repo.

packageRules.description: shipkit publishes libraries: pinning their runtime dependencies would force exact copies on every consumer. Published dependency ranges are widened, not pinned; dev tooling stays pinned.
Packages released from this repo (store-ship depends on worker-push) move with the release workflow, not Renovate.
